messages:
Maya (Product): ACME asked for a tight beta: "compact multimodal summary" by Friday. Need a quick owner map and known risks.
Noah (Eng): Timeline tight. Main unknowns: image ingestion contract and graceful degrade to text-only. Also quantization variance might change quality.
Priya (Runtime): Runtime needs a small shim to treat image embeddings as pseudo-tokens and a KV-cache TTL tweak. I can spike this but need a staging GPU pool to bench.
Jamal (Infra): I can carve 2x A10g for 72h in staging. Tell me expected GPU mem and disk life for image decode.
Priya (Runtime): Expect peak ~18GB GPU memory. Disk ephemeral for decode only; images purged immediately after processing. Batch profile: batch=6, ~400 tokens + one image (~1.2MB).
Elena (Security): Images can include PII. Required: no persistent storage, strip EXIF, short-lived signed upload URLs. I need 48h for a threat review; if not ready, we gate access and enforce mitigations.
Tomas (CS): ACME signed DPA and ok with staged beta (500 users). They want rollback criteria and a clear acceptance rubric.
Noah (Eng): Rollout idea: feature flag -> canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Need gateway kill-switch and a runtime fast-fail for oversized images (>2MB).
Priya (Runtime): I'll add fast-fail + cache-bypass toggle. ETA 36h with unit tests.
ops-bot: Staging host pending provisioning.
Jamal (Infra): Provision command I'll run tonight (internal-only):
```
terraform apply -var='env=staging' -var='pool=acme-multimodal-beta' -var='gpu_type=A10g' -auto-approve
```
I'll also set up a restricted subdomain and mTLS cert.
Noah (Eng): I'll draft API contract: POST /v1/summarize {text, images:[url|base64], mode}. Error modes: 415 bad image, 200 with warning header when degraded to text-only. I'll open a PR with e2e fixtures.
Maya (Product): ACME acceptance targets: p95 text-only <700ms; p95 multimodal <1.2s; quality metric F1 >= 0.80. Also need opt-out flag for image processing.
Elena (Security): Interim mitigations if threat review misses 48h: upload TTL=30s, limited SSO access, no analytics export. I'll post the checklist by EOD.
Maya (Product): Action owners recap:
- Elena: threat checklist + confirmation by EOD (security)
- Jamal: staging GPU pool + internal endpoint + mTLS tonight (infra)
- Priya: token shim + cache TTL + fast-fail + tests in 36h (runtime)
- Noah: API contract + e2e tests + perf harness in 48h (eng)
- Tomas: confirm ACME beta window + acceptance rubric today (CS)
Noah (Eng): Add telemetry hooks: trace_id, p50/p95/p99, token_count, image_size, cost per request. Need observability schema.
Maya (Product): Include eval prompt set and regression alert on quality. If blockers pop up, we'll call a 15m standup. :rocket:
